title: One-to-many (1:N)
summary: Model publishers that own many magazines.
description:
Model publishers that own many magazines.

Why: 1:N is the workhorse relationship. Putting the FK on the magazine (child) is what lets one publisher own many magazines without duplicating publisher rows.
